text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was cut by five points on Thursday to 1,423 points and at 1300 GMT BIFFEX was six points down to 10 points up in a turnover of 76 lots.

Among fixtures being reported by brokers was amended details of Hajin's fixture of the 1995 built Maria Bottiglieri 75,265 dwt which has been booked for Dec 14/22 delivery USGulf redelivery Far East at $14,000 daily plus $270,000 bonus. On Wednesday the vessel was said taken by K-Line for delivery Antwerp early Dec trip via Brazil redelivery Indonesia at $15,000 daily.
Elsewhere 1983 built Zoodotis 55,000 dwt was taken by Klaveness for dap from Tampa to North China at $23.10 for Dec 172/26.
